chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah from Aban from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): that he was asked
Does the fasting person engage in intercourse or kiss in the month of Ramadan? He said, 'I fear for him, so let him abstain from that unless he is confident that his semen will not precede it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on kissing or sexual intercourse for a fasting person in Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of *khawf* (fear of breaking the fast) as the primary criterion for permissible intimacy during Ramadan, advising caution to preserve the sanctity of the fast. This ruling reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on precaution (*ihtiyat*) in acts of worship, distinguishing between mere desire and the actual release of semen. The narration, transmitted through the reliable chain of al-Tusi's *Tahdhib*, underscores that confidence in self-control permits intimacy, while uncertainty necessitates abstention to avoid invalidating the fast.
